retrieved.title: Withdrawal review
retrieved.text: Withdrawals may be placed into manual review for security checks. Most reviews complete within 24 hours, but some may take longer if additional verification is required.

retrieved.title: Password reset
retrieved.text: Users can reset their password from the login page using the 'Forgot password' link. Password reset emails usually arrive within 5 minutes. Support agents cannot manually view existing passwords.

retrieved.title: Address verification
retrieved.text: Accepted proof of address documents include utility bills and bank statements dated within the last 6 months. Screenshots are not accepted.
